🦌 KY WMA closures next weekend (Nov 21–22) 📻

⛔ US-3837 West Kentucky WMA: Nov 21–24, closed to everyone except drawn hunters (plus one helper each) for the deer quota hunt. The shooting ranges are closed too, and Tract 1, Tracts 1A, 2A, 4A and parts of 7A stay closed to public use.

⛔ US-1255 Fishtrap Lake WMA: Nov 21–22, closed to everyone except drawn hunters (plus one helper each) for the deer quota hunt.

⛔ US-3805 Curtis Gates Lloyd WMA: closed through Sat Nov 21 for the quota hunt, except the club ranges, fishing pond and trail.

⛔ US-3831 South Shore WMA: closed to all public access except waterfowl and dove hunting, through Jan 15.

Check before you go: https://app.fw.ky.gov/Public_Lands_Search/
73 and stay safe out there! – KPC

🦌 KY WMA closures this weekend (Nov 14–15) 📻

⛔ US-3805 Curtis Gates Lloyd WMA: Nov 14–21, the huntable portion is closed to everyone except drawn deer quota hunters, and the tube range is closed too. The club ranges, fishing pond and hiking trail stay open.

⛔ US-3831 South Shore WMA: starting Sun Nov 15 (through Jan 15), closed to all hunting and public access except waterfowl and dove hunting.

Check before you go: https://app.fw.ky.gov/Public_Lands_Search/
73 and stay safe out there! – KPC

Have you booked  your campsite?!

We will announce the 2027 campout to the broader ham community tomorrow, 28 OCT. If you live in Kentucky, or attended the inaugural campout, get your RV or tent site today!

Look for us on the Ham Radio Adventure Guy and Ham Radio Kids Table livestreams tomorrow at 8:00 pm EDT!
